declarations.description:
Class containing the video player as well as all the logic for video playback, interactive elements, controls, file input, and more.
This class extends the `LitElementWw` class.
declarations.name: WebwriterInteractiveVideo

members.name: scopedElements
members.description:
Returns an object that maps custom element names to their corresponding classes.
These custom elements can be used within the scope of the `webwriter-interactive-video` component.

members.name: videoContext
members.description: The context for the interactive video component, containing all widget data in a JSON object.

members.name: hideInteractions
members.description: Whether interactions should be shown

members.name: hideChapters
members.description: Whether the video has chapters and they should be shown

members.name: disablePlaybackRateChange
members.description: Whether the user is allowed to change the playback rate

members.name: videoBase64
members.description: Video file as a base64 string for offline storage.

members.name: videoURL
members.description: Video URL for online playback.

members.name: videoLoaded

members.description: Waveform data for audio visualization generated by WaveSurfer.js.

members.name: chapterConfig
members.description: Contains the current chapter configuration as an object.

members.name: videoPlayer
members.description: The video player element

members.description: Renders the overlay elements for the video.

members.name: updateContext
members.description: Updates the videoContext attribute and requests an update.

members.name: calculateVideoAreaSize
members.description: Calculates the size of the video area based on the aspect ratio and container dimensions.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: The time in seconds to jump to.

members.description: Jumps to a specific time stamp in the video.

members.name: interactionClicked

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: the ID of the interaction that was clicked

members.description: Handles the click event on an interaction element.

members.name: baubleClicked

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: the ID of the interaction associated with the clicked bauble

members.description: Handles the click event on a bauble in the progress bar.

members.name: changeInteractionStartTime

parameters.name: newTime
parameters.description: new start time for the interaction

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: the ID of the interaction to update

members.description: Changes the start time of an interaction and updates its end time to be 5 seconds later.

members.name: getCurrentChapter
members.description: Retrieves the current chapter based on the current time of the video.

members.name: hasVideo
members.description: Checks whether a video is already existing on load.

members.name: addVideoInteraction

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: the ID to assign to the new interaction

members.description: Adds a new video interaction element to the video at the current time.

members.name: handleVideoClick
members.description: Handles the click event on the video element.

parameters.description: The MouseEvent object representing the click event.
parameters.name: e

members.name: toggleChaptersDrawer
members.description: Toggles the chapters drawer open or closed.

members.name: handleVolumeChange

parameters.description: The custom event object.
parameters.name: e

members.description: Handles the change event for the volume slider and sets the video volume accordingly.

members.name: toggleMute
members.description: Handles the click event for the mute button.

parameters.description: The custom event object.
parameters.name: e

members.name: changePlaybackRate

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The new playback rate value.

members.description: Sets the video playback rate (speed) to the specified value.

members.name: updateBaublePositions
members.description: Updates the positions of the baubles in the widget.

members.name: hideAllInteractions
members.description: Hides all interactions on the video and resets their hasPaused attribute.

members.name: closeChaptersDrawer
members.description: Closes the chapters drawer.

members.name: handleTimeUpdate
members.description:
Handles the time update event of the video player and check whether there are interactions to be displayed by comparing current call time to last.
This way we dont skip any interactions and dont fire twice since this is called inconsistently.

parameters.description: The custom event object.
parameters.name: e

members.name: handleTimeSkip

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The amount of time to skip (in seconds). Positive values skip forward, negative values skip backward.

members.description: Handles time skips through keyboard shortcuts

members.name: handleProgressChange
members.description: Handles the progress change event and updates the video's progress bar and time stamp based on the current video time.

parameters.description: The custom event object.
parameters.name: e

members.name: toggleFullscreen
members.description: Enables or disables fullscreen mode.

members.name: handleFullscreenChange
members.description: Handles the fullscreen change event by repositioning the baubles to fit the new video size.

members.name: handleMouseMove
members.description: Handles mouse movement in fullscreen mode to show the controls when the mouse is moved.

parameters.description: The MouseEvent object representing the mouse movement event.
parameters.name: e

members.name: handleControlMouseEnter
members.description: Handles mouse enter the controls in fullscreen mode to prevent hiding the controls while hovering over them.

parameters.description: The MouseEvent object representing the mouse hover event.
parameters.name: e

members.name: handleControlMouseLeave
members.description: Handles mouse leave the controls in fullscreen mode to allow hiding the controls again.

parameters.description: The MouseEvent object representing the mouse hover event.
parameters.name: e

members.name: setupVideoBase64

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The base64-encoded video source.

members.description: Sets up the video player with a base64-encoded video source.

members.name: setupVideoURL

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The video URL.

members.description: Sets up the video player with a YouTube or video URL.

members.name: startLoading
members.description:
Resets the loading state before a source is handed to the player and starts the load timeout,
so that a source which never becomes playable ends up in the error view instead of a dead player.

members.name: retryLoad
members.description: Loads the current source again, e.g. after a network error.

members.name: chooseDifferentSource
members.description:
Discards the failed source so the author can pick another one, keeping their interactions and chapters.
The error message stays visible in the video input.

members.name: togglePlayVideo
members.description: Toggles the playback of the video. If the video has ended, it resets the current time to 0.

members.name: playVideo
members.description: Plays the video.

members.name: pauseVideo
members.description: Pauses the video.

members.name: getContrastColor

parameters.name: hexColor
parameters.description: The hex color value.

members.description: Calculates the contrast color based on the given hex color.

members.name: handleOverlayClicked
members.description: Handles the click event on the overlay element by calling the clickEventHelper function with the id of the interaction.

parameters.description: The MouseEvent object representing the click event.
parameters.name: event

members.name: handleCanPlay
members.description:
Handles the 'canplay' event of the video element.

This function is called when the video can be played.

members.name: handleDurationChange
members.description: Handles the duration change event of the video element.

members.name: handleLoadingError

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: The technical error, for the console.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: A localized message explaining the error to the user.

members.description: Handles loading errors for the video element.

members.name: clearVideo
members.description: Clears the current video and resets the video context and player.

members.name: monitorSlot
members.description: Monitors the slot for changes and handles fullscreen changes and interaction removals.

parameters.description: List of mutations to be monitored
parameters.name: mutationList

declarations.description:
`webwriter-video-interaction` is a custom element that represents an interaction in a `replace` interaction.
It extends `LitElementWw` and provides a slot for content insertion.
declarations.name: WwVideoInteraction

members.name: hasPaused
